purpose: Public-safe operating prospectus for every Actions control exposed by Buddy.
truth_boundary: A prospectus explains purpose, evidence, controls, progress, and value. It is not proof that a workflow is healthy or that an investment return is guaranteed.

controls.name: Run Doctor
controls.purpose: Find common repository, runtime, dependency, configuration, and connection problems before deeper debugging.
controls.investor_value: Reduces maintenance time and makes system health measurable.
controls.success: All applicable doctor checks pass with evidence.
controls.fallback: Leave failed checks visible and produce owner-action guidance.

controls.name: Run Tests
controls.purpose: Execute repository tests and preserve the first reproducible failure.
controls.investor_value: Protects shipped functionality and reduces regression risk.
controls.success: Applicable tests pass; blocked tests are explicitly reported.
controls.fallback: Run focused tests and record blocker.

controls.name: Run Lint
controls.purpose: Check formatting, lint, imports, types, and static quality without weakening rules.
controls.investor_value: Improves maintainability and lowers engineering friction.

controls.name: Security Check
controls.purpose: Check dependencies, public/private boundaries, permissions, and secret exposure.
controls.fallback: Block promotion and create owner-action item.

controls.name: Benchmark Locally
controls.purpose: Measure quality, latency, throughput, efficiency, reliability, and reproducibility on the current device.
controls.investor_value: Makes capability and operating efficiency measurable instead of anecdotal.
controls.success: Results meet the registered benchmark threshold with repeat evidence.
controls.fallback: Mark unverified or blocked; never fabricate a score.

controls.name: Find Repair Plan
controls.purpose: Convert failures into a smallest-safe repair with rollback and dependent regression tests.
controls.investor_value: Turns failures into trackable engineering work and limits unnecessary changes.
controls.success: Repair is verified by evidence and recurrence falls or remains absent.

controls.name: Verify Pages Data
controls.purpose: Verify that repository evidence, benchmarks, Actions state, and generated catalogs reach the public dashboard.
controls.investor_value: Makes product progress auditable and understandable.
controls.success: Required public datasets exist, validate, and render.

controls.name: Prepare Device Bundle
controls.purpose: Validate the downloadable Buddy runtime and device-local execution boundary.
controls.investor_value: Creates a reproducible path for users to run Buddy without giving the website arbitrary machine access.
controls.success: Supported package builds and launches under its documented permissions.
controls.fallback: Publish exact build blocker; do not claim the package is bug-free.

controls.name: Refresh GitHub Runs
controls.purpose: Read current public GitHub Actions run evidence and associate it with workflow records.
controls.investor_value: Keeps the dashboard tied to observable repository execution.
controls.success: Current public run evidence is loaded and timestamped.
controls.fallback: Use static evidence and mark live state unavailable.

mastery_rule: Only repeatable, test-backed evidence may move a control to mastered. Prospectus status never substitutes for verification.
